newsitem.title: LATVIA: SHKELE DOUBTS INFLATION BELOW 7 PCT END '98.
newsitem.headline: SHKELE DOUBTS INFLATION BELOW 7 PCT END '98.

text.p: Latvian Prime Minister Andris Shkele does not believe that inflation will be lower than seven percent at the end of next year.
"It will not be getting lower than seven percent," he told Reuters in an interview.
Shkele warned that investments in the consumer area will cause swings in inflation and also fuel it.
For the current year Shkele repeated the target to reach an inflation rate of nine percent towards the end of the year.
